remarks: Location! Location! This beautiful 2-bedroom, 1-bath corner unit is full of comfort and convenience in the sought-after Dundee School District. The property includes a separately deeded garage with a storage loft, perfect for additional storage or hobbies. This home is ideal for families looking to settle in a community-oriented neighborhood. The bright and airy interior features updated kitchen appliances, wall-to-wall carpeting in the bedrooms, and an in-unit washer/dryer for added convenience. There's also a shared laundry facility on the first floor. Private individual garage space included. The building's main entrance and hallways have been tastefully renovated. Discover this hidden gem nestled in the heart of Old Greenwich!
